label: run-01
method: One agent per shard of 25 questions, 18 shards. Each agent was given the question ids and text only, plus the path to R9_1_GX_CLI_Reference/, and was forbidden to read anything under tools/ so the expected facts and reference answers could not leak. Each was told to answer as if to an operator, in roughly 400-800 characters, using the guide's own spelling for identifiers and values.
corpus_note: The command files are byte-exact slices of the source and have never changed. index/topics.md has changed since, at 1708f63, which added revocation / signing request / distribution point and removed 'what can' and 'stop'. A rerun therefore reads a slightly better index than this run did.
score_note: Scored 427/441 against the tests at 1708f63. The difference is entirely test repair, not answer quality: the facts were demanding material the questions never asked for. Compare runs only at the same tests commit, which is what compare_runs.py does by scoring every run against the working tree.
